his_statement: The two-dimensional tame local lemma, with Abhyankar to be made explicit.
statement: Let A be regular local of dimension2 with regular parameters x,y. A finite normal Galois extension B/A of group order invertible in A, branched only in V(x) and completely split at the generic point of V(y), is étale. his_statement: Restriction of an injective sheaf to a closed subset need not be flasque.
statement: Let X be an irreducible space containing two irreducible closed curves Y1,Y2 meeting only at p, and let I be the sheaf of arbitrary Q-valued functions on X. The section of I|_(Y−{p}) equal to the constant germ0 on Y1−{p} and1 on Y2−{p} does not extend to Y: an ambient function representing a germ at p would have to be0 and1 on two nonempty intersecting open neighborhoods. Thus I|Y is not flasque.
